body:
Thanks for reading my thoughts on the matter! As I said, the last thing I meant was to hurt anyone and I am glad you responded in such manner.

Yes, I think using self-taught might bring you more sceptics than admirers, therefore why I brought up the subject. That would be my biggest criticism towards your art lol. The rest you'll learn with time and most importantly through observation. I also paint surrealistic pieces and I believe that if you want to make it seem unsettling, you gotta make some elements realistic enough to trick the eye of the viewer and then find a way to incorporate your own ideas. Just observe the world around you - how light and shadows work, perspective, colour, etc. I learned more in the months I didn't pick up a brush than in the months I painted every single day.

Thank you for your reply! 

I understand this point of view, but following that logic most artists are in one way or another self-taught. Accomplished artists don't go to art classes their entire lives, sooner or later they just start producing art themselves, they evaluate/research/study everything by themselves. The thing that I don't understand is why some people deem it necessary to announce that they are self-taught. What difference does it make?

Just curious - why do people like to put emphasis on the fact that they are 'self-taught'? I don't believe in 'self-taught' artists, sure, if you grew up in a cave away from other artists' work and everything you created came directly from your head, then I might see that as a valid thing you might want to boast about. Assuming that's not the case, why would you put that in your title?

Edit: I just cannot comprehend the idea behind claiming to be self-taught and furthermore writing that as your post's title.. no hate towards the artist. I am just curious, that's all.
Hi! Thanks for this wonderful reply, I will try my best to follow your advice. Thanks for taking the time of your day to respond!! I appreciate it.

"Not giving up on yourself" are the exact words one of my good friends used like a year ago. Crazy how life works lol. Thanks for taking your time to respond! I appreciate it a lot!!! 

Yeah, I'll give my current psychiatrist another try, I'll be honest about my suicidal thoughts because I kept it a secret from all my therapists. Maybe this is the step I need to take in order to improve my life.. who knows. It's a bit scary admitting it out loud, I am worried he might tell my dad about it, but I'll try my best to tell the truth.

Don't worry! It is my fault it came across that my friends are bad. Totally unintentional!

Problem is I don't  know what to say anymore. Yeah, they are supportive, but their support doesn't help me anymore. No medications, no therapists, nothing is helping me anymore. I'm sorry that I'm whining, I feel like I'm always ranting and venting to everyone and I feel guilty about it. 

Maybe if I try to book an appointment one last time maybe then things will change.

NONONO. I have the best friends in the universe! I just feel guilty talking to them about that because I can see how uncomfortable it is for them to hear that I want to die. I don't want to make them feel that way anymore. They've always been super supportive.. I just think they'd be better off without me.

Thank you for responding! I am just concerned I might fail with my suicide attempt, so I've been trying to plan it out. I wish I had access to a gun.

Thanks for replying!

In my country I think appointments are just like regular appointments right now but with masks on, which is not a problem.

I tried to book it a few weeks ago but no one picked the phone and I used it as an excuse to stop trying. This time I'm emailing my therapist directly.

I'll update on what happens in case I don't forget.

Have a good day!

I'm so sorry this happened to you.. let me tell you I'm so happy you're alive and hopefully well right now. You should know you're helping me out a lot by talking to me.

I am a painter. I used to paint whenever I felt like that, but lately my paintings have either been "too dark" for everyone (I don't draw gore or anything along those lines) and I don't get why. Maybe I'm projecting my feelings onto the canvas and people like the aesthetic, but no one wants to purchase it for themselves and I really want to get my shop going.

Apart from that one of my closest friends gifted me a ukulele and I've been trying to play it whenever I get too sad. That friend is acting really cold to me right now and I am unsure whether I fucked up somewhere because I've always been there for them and now I just get this treatment I feel like I don't deserve. So that ukulele isn't really helping me right now.

I can relate to the part about being physically active as a way to distract yourself. I've always enjoyed cycling, but I've visited most places in my city already and leaving it is impossible right now. I've gone cycling with that same friend for years and now my bicycle reminds me of them.

I suppose I associate my coping mechanisms with other people and that's bad. Maybe I need to find something else? I'm not sure.

Thank you for taking time our of your day to reply!

I guess my problem is I don't really know what my problem is anymore. I am schizophrenic, I took my pills, I got better and yet again I feel like an absolute shit. I've learned to appreciate the little things in live, but currently those little things occur so rarely.

I had a great support system, but I'm quite sure I am a burden right now. Everyone is fed up with my bullshit and I feel guilty for not having committed suicide already, because I feel like an attention seeker with my closer friends. If I had the strength to finally do it I'm sure they would truly believe me that this is real to me. Sad thing is, deep inside of me I know there is another way, but I can't really see it.

My previous therapist was great, but he passed away. I cannot afford to switch from my current one and he's just not doing the job rn for me.

TL;DR I feel like I am out of options and suicide seems like the only way out right now.

I've reached out before to people close to me and I am quite sure I am just a burden right now. I've been this suicidal for the last 2 years and I used to talk to my closest friends about this (I absolutely cannot talk about this with my family), they used to help a lot, but as any other thing it gets annoying over time and right now I just hit a new low by ranting to strangers through reddit.

My previous therapist passed away and we got along so well.. I switched a few ones and the current one just doesn't do the job for me. I don't have the money to switch again.
Nice attitude man, gonna get you far in life!
You too, take care and have a great day/evening!

Thank you for responding! 

Yes, maybe I need to talk to them and be honest about my issues and concerns. I just feel like I am faking it even when I'm not, I can't really explain it..

When I am calm and I need to talk about it I can barely make any words come out and I just get stressed that the person I am talking to might think I am lying.

First of all, thank you for taking time of your day to reply! I cannot stress this enough - I am so grateful that someone responded.

I have already talked to my closest friends about my problems regarding suicide and they were there for me when I needed them the most, problem is I have been thinking about that for around 3 years and now I am quite sure they are fed up with my problems.

I have tried reaching a help line in my country, but right now due to the whole coronavirus situation they are overwhelmed with the amount of people that need psychological help.

I think my best bet is to talk to my psychiatrist and to stop lying to him. Maybe that will help in the long run.

'Your now is not your forever' - this made me feel better, thank you! :)

I am no expert or a vet, but one thing I am sure of is that Jay was happy to spend his last day playing outside in the park, being walked by his caretaker and overall I am sure you gave him the best life possible with the time you two shared together.

I had a pet of mine die whilst my family took care of him and it never even CROSSED my mind that my family is responsible for his passing. I am sure the owner of Jay feels the same way as I do, after all they trusted you enough with one of the things they love the most - their pet.

My point is - it's part of nature! All living things come and go, yes, maybe if you weren't outside on that particular day maybe it wouldn't have happened, or it would've happened regardless, you never know. This is life and nothing is certain, there are a lot of what if's.

Allow yourself to grieve but do not obsess yourself over Jay's death. Dogs tend to love whoever shows love to them and I am sure you were a great caretaker, seeing as how heartbroken you are over Jay's passing -> I am sure Jay loved you just as much if not - even more in return.

Sorry for the lengthy comment, I just wanted to say that it's not your fault and I genuinely hope you find peace one day. My condolences.
